mapper.select: SELECT S.ID AS "id" ,S.SYMBOL AS "symbol" ,S.NAME AS "name" ,S.MARKET AS "market" ,S.SECURITY_TYPE AS "securityType" FROM T_STOCK S WHERE 1=1 AND S.SYMBOL = #{symbol} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL
SELECT TO_CHAR(P.TRADE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day" ,P.CLOSE_PRICE AS "close" FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND P.CLOSE_PRICE > 0 ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE
